title: How to Properly Recycle Egg Shells
steps: Rinse to remove egg residue and let them dry.
Crush the eggshells into small pieces for faster decomposition.
Add crushed eggshells to your compost bin or home garden soil.
Eggshells enrich the compost with calcium and improve soil structure.
Encourage others to compost eggshells instead of throwing them in regular trash.
Spread awareness of the benefits of eggshell composting.
precautions: Do not compost large quantities at once to avoid imbalance.
Ensure eggshells are clean and dry before composting.
Avoid adding eggshells with raw egg residue to prevent attracting pests.
Do not throw eggshells in plastic waste bins.
